tenderSchedule.description: Selection Of Consultancy Firm / Agency For Zonal Project Management Consultancy (PMC) Services For Construction Supervision, Quality & Quantity Audit, DPR Preparation And Tender Assistance For Kalaburagi Zone Of KRIDL.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: 4th Floor, Grameenaabhiruddi Bhavana, Ananda Rao Circle

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

PMC Consultant/Tenderer shall be permitted to apply for a maximum of two (2) Zones only. If a PMC Consultant/Tenderer applies for two (2) Zones, the Technical and Financial Qualification criteria shall be considered cumulatively for two (2) Zones.
All Other Conditions Stipulated in Bid Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultant shall have experience of Project Management Consultancy, construction supervision, or quality and quantity audit assignments of a minimum aggregate value of Rs. 300 crore in the last five financial years, for a Government, Semi Government or Public Sector Undertaking client. Evidence copy of the work order or contract and the experience certificate issued by the client for each assignment relied upon.
Consultants having an in-house NABL accredited laboratory.
Consultants holding ISO 9001 certification for quality management systems and ISO 14001 certification for environmental management systems

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- ISO 9001 certification and ISO 14001 certification

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff proposed for the Assignment, assessed on educational qualification, professional experience, like a Team Leader (Zonal), Quality Supervisor, Structural Engineer (MTech Structures), Transportation Engineer (MTech Transportation), Construction Manager and Assistant Construction Managers.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultant shall have achieved, in any two years during the last five financial years, a minimum financial turnover of Rs.14 crore by way of consultancy fee. Evidence certificate of a CA bearing a (UDIN), together with certified financial statements for the relevant years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Approach and methodology - appreciation of and response to the Terms of Reference

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All Other Document as per tender document
Last 5 Years Income Tax Returns Copies
Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff
